name: Analyze Circular Dichroism Spectra
description: Analyzes circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy data to determine secondary structure and thermal stability.
detailed_description: Analyzes circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy data to determine secondary structure and thermal stability.
when_to_use: When you need analyze circular dichroism spectra analysis

parameters.wavelength_data: [Required] Wavelength values in nm for CD spectrum (list or numpy.ndarray)
parameters.cd_signal_data: [Required] CD signal intensity values (typically in mdeg or Δε) (list or numpy.ndarray)
parameters.temperature_data: [Optional] Temperature values (°C) for thermal denaturation experiment
parameters.thermal_cd_data: [Optional] CD signal values at specific wavelength across different temperatures
